# Voice bar (`voice-bar`)

Stands in for the composer during a voice conversation (animated mosaic) or dictation (live waveform).

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createVoiceBar` (types in `dist/web/feedback/voiceBar.d.ts`): `.mh-voice-bar`: shown in place of a composer during a voice conversation or dictation, the same height.

```ts
export function createVoiceBar(options: VoiceBarOptions = {}): VoiceBarHandle;

export interface VoiceBarOptions {
  variant?: VoiceBarVariant;
  /** Default `listening`. */
  phase?: VoicePhase;
  /** Input level, 0–1: scales the mosaic while listening; each new level adds a bar to the dictation waveform. */
  level?: number;
  /** Status text; defaults to the phase's (`VOICE_PHASE_LABELS`). */
  label?: string;

  /** Conversation: before the mosaic, e.g. a "type instead" button. */
  leading?: Child | Child[];
  /** Conversation: pressing the mosaic (interrupt, listen again). Without it the mosaic is decorative. */
  onTap?: () => void;
  /** Conversation: the end button. */
  onEnd?: () => void;
  /** Default "End conversation". */
  endLabel?: string;

  /** Dictation: the done button shows a spinner and can't be pressed. */
  busy?: boolean;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  /** Default "Cancel". */
  cancelLabel?: string;
  onDone?: () => void;
  /** Default "Done". */
  doneLabel?: string;
}

export interface VoiceBarHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setPhase(phase: VoicePhase): void;
  /** Sets the level; in dictation, also adds it to the waveform. */
  setLevel(level: number): void;
  /** `undefined` goes back to the phase's text. */
  setLabel(label: string | undefined): void;
  setBusy(busy: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createVoiceBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Stands in for the microphone's input level (0–1).
const levels = setInterval(() => bar.setLevel(Math.random()), 90);

const bar = createVoiceBar({
  variant: 'dictation',
  onCancel: () => {
    clearInterval(levels);
    bar.setPhase('idle');
  },
  onDone: () => {
    clearInterval(levels);
    bar.setPhase('transcribing');
    bar.setBusy(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      bar.setBusy(false);
      bar.setPhase('idle');
      bar.setLabel('Added: "Buy more coffee filters"');
    }, 1500);
  },
});

document.body.append(bar.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { VoiceBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { VoicePhase } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function VoiceBarExample() {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<VoicePhase>('listening');
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [label, setLabel] = useState<string>();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'listening') return;
    // Stands in for the microphone's input level (0–1).
    const timer = setInterval(() => setLevel(Math.random()), 90);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [phase]);
  const done = () => {
    setPhase('transcribing');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setPhase('idle');
      setLabel('Added: "Buy more coffee filters"');
    }, 1500);
  };
  return (
    <VoiceBar
      variant="dictation"
      phase={phase}
      level={level}
      label={label}
      busy={phase === 'transcribing'}
      onCancel={() => setPhase('idle')}
      onDone={done}
    />
  );
}
```
